annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin participation through a signup link and membership flow tied to token withdrawal, mining, and coin conversion. It claims future price growth and that OneCoin will make participants rich. The sampled slides also include credibility-building imagery and a non-guarantee disclaimer, though the available video evidence does not establish actual payment, realized returns, or victim losses.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation links joining OneCoin and converting tokens into coins with projected cryptocurrency price growth and a wealth outcome. This supports a token participation or acquisition pathway tied to appreciation claims. The future price transcription is unclear, so the assessment relies on the supported qualitative appreciation relationship rather than a precise price figure.
